title: Pickup scheduled confirmation
description: Confirm a scheduled pickup with date, window and address. Utility WhatsApp template for freight, couriers and moving companies.
notes: Add the pickup address and a driver contact when available. Instructions about packaging are welcome if short.

body.text: Hi {{first_name}}, your pickup is booked for *{{date}}* between {{window}} at {{address}}. Please have the shipment packed and labeled.
